exclusions.reason: Cover/date and contact details are provenance/incidental; no delivery inferred.

Approval, requests to reconsider necessity and clarify correction, and preferred limits on any future notarial duty are recommendations. Material legal, technical and cost premises are inventoried; speculative future duty is not treated as enacted.
Support for digitisation and prediction that many municipal processes will use NOOTS are preferences/forecasts, not realised deployment counts.

Preferred early interfaces, data scope, availability, migration/test environments and reuse of standards are design requests. Conditional future reductions in duplication/cost are not measured savings; exact existing XJustiz premise separately checked.
Cover, committee/contact/list of recipients are incidental. Membership and organisational self-description on p2 are not material to the identifier argument.

Requested accelerated commencement and removal/relocation of personal display fields are normative legal-design proposals. Claimed future sufficiency and speed are not observed outcomes; no automatic GDPR violation is inferred from the existing lawful field list.
Cover, contact and membership/self-description are provenance/incidental.

Support, proposed corrections, future traffic growth, desired availability and limits on future ID reporting are recommendations or forecasts. Current reliability and historical outage assertions retained as unresolved; individual data-quality possibility separately tested.
Expected future quality/efficiency gains and request to shorten the principal deadline are forecasts/preferences. Both statutory/proposed deadlines separately checked.

Cadastre inclusion and wording proposals, future quality gains, proposed exchange, internal-only publication design and preferred target architecture are recommendations; current data role and access premises separately assessed.

Preference for current official inspection over citizen-supplied extracts is evaluative; no general empirical or legal-safety ranking established. Future municipal benefits and transition safeguards are requests rather than observed access failures.

Potential future software, ALKIS, training/migration and organisational costs are conditional forecasts, explicitly unquantified. No realised amount or universal unfunded burden is asserted. Financing allocation is a policy request.

Requests for responsibilities, privacy safeguards, access, corrections and financing are normative; no current breach or intent inferred. Current statutory purpose limits and registration-authority role separately checked. Conclusion repeats proposals.

Letterhead/date/self-description and broad examples of future bureaucratic or planning gains are incidental, rhetorical or forecasts. Image-only substantive legal/data-role assertions retained with visual anchors.
Cadastre inclusion and future process/data-quality gains are policy proposals and conditional forecasts; exact existing interface and common-key premises separately checked.
Image-only cover letter, date, role/self-description and support for future efficiencies are provenance or policy. Complete image page read; no omitted unique quantified assertion.

Benefits for BIM, infrastructure, planning, quality and acceptance are general technical-policy rationale or predicted consequences without measured gains. Material register role, person-data basis and broad task scope separately assessed; not every aspiration becomes an unresolved claim.

Cadastre inclusion, extension of proposed transition, explicit quality-assurance exchange and expected staff relief are recommendations/forecasts. Current asserted staff trend and statutory coordination separately checked.
